rule: This file is fixed before any P1 or P2 measurement. Any later change is a new versioned file and is reported as a deviation.

p1.pair_selection_rule: Train only; per season, sort pair ids lexicographically and take the first N (3 summer, 3 autumn, 2 winter). No outcome-based selection.
p1.critic_mode: train mode with a fixed torch seed per replicate; an eval-mode forward is recorded as a dropout sensitivity check

classification.IMMEDIATE_DEGRADATION: arm 1 mean delta <= -1.0 CNY/day and its 95% CI excludes 0
classification.CUMULATIVE_DEGRADATION: mean delta non-increasing over arms 1,5,10 and arm 10 <= -1.0 with its 95% CI excluding 0
classification.SHORT_TERM_IMPROVEMENT_LONG_TERM_DEGRADA: arm 1 >= +1.0 with CI excluding 0 and arm 10 <= -1.0 with CI excluding 0
classification.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else, or the two seeds disagree, or a guard fails

direction_probe.construction: normalize the mean actor gradient over 5 batches to unit L2, then scale so the largest change among open quotes equals the target displacement

interpretation.B_critic_ranking: batch Q rises by >0.5% while the full-day payoff falls by >1.0 CNY/day
interpretation.A_actor_path: batch Q falls by >0.5% while the full-day payoff falls, or gate-logit gradient dominates with no quote movement
interpretation.aligned_local: Q and payoff both rise by more than the thresholds
interpretation.no_signal: neither Q nor payoff moves beyond the thresholds

guards: checkpoint tree sha256 unchanged before and after
all critic and critic-target parameters bitwise equal after every arm
no trainer.save, no buffer add, no target soft update

grid.design: one-at-a-time; the swept leg and the other three ESS keep the policy action elsewhere
grid.gate: gate open at every grid point; the policy action as executed and the all-truthful (0,0) arm are separate reference rows

ranking.valid: median Spearman(Q_min, payoff) >= 0.5 AND top-1 agreement >= 0.5
ranking.invalid: median Spearman(Q_min, payoff) <= 0.1 OR top-1 agreement <= 0.25

p2.no_signal: the payoff range across the 5-point grid is < 1.0 CNY/day in >= 75% of sweeps
p2.reward_mismatch: median Spearman(training return, payoff) < 0.99; the telescoping identity predicts exactly 1.0
p2.inversion: count states where Q(policy) > Q(truthful) and payoff(policy) < payoff(truthful); a rate >= 0.75 supports B

criteria: agent submits a price quote to a clearing that sets nodal prices
observation contains own state and market history, no future prices
episodic storage SOC dynamics over a multi-block day
settlement uses nodal or two-settlement prices
action is a charge/discharge price pair, not a direct quantity
external_comparability.run_threshold: at least 4 of 5 criteria match on one environment
external_comparability.rule: if the threshold is not met, record NOT_COMPARABLE and do not install; a benchmark score is never reported as MakerB policy performance

p2.clearing_failure_rule: a failed clearing on one grid point is recorded as CLEARING_FAILED and excluded from that sweep; it is not retried and does not abort the state

decision_table.C: P2 measures a deviation from the discounted-return identity gamma^23 * delta / 1000, or the B1 reference used by the reward differs from the one used by validation
decision_table.B: P2 ranking is invalid and P1 shows batch Q rising while the true payoff falls (or the inversion rate >= 0.75)
decision_table.A: P2 ranking is valid or ambiguous and P1 shows the actor step does not ascend batch Q, or the gate-logit gradient dominates with no quote movement
decision_table.D: P2 reports no_signal in >= 75% of sweeps, with P1 also showing no measurable effect
decision_table.NO_GO_ROOT_CAUSE_UNRESOLVED: evidence is conflicting, below threshold, or rests on one line

p3.return_identity: gamma^23 * delta / 1000; B is paid only at block 23 and C2 shaping telescopes to zero at the terminal
